extracted.intended_audience: consumers/readers looking for the best HBO Max subscription deals and pricing options
extracted.subtask_description: A consumer-facing guide to the best current HBO Max deals, discounts, and subscription plans, including bundles, student pricing, plan features, and what's available to stream. Helps readers choose the most cost-effective option for their needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Top pick — Disney+, Hulu, and HBO Max streaming bundle
rubrics_metrics.description: Our favorite streaming bundle includes Disney Plus, Hulu, and HBO Max. The deal can be purchased through any of the three streaming services and starts at $19.99/month for the ad-supported tier or $32.99/month for ad-free access across all three platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This bundle is presented as the 'Top Pick' when looking for savings: 'It'll save you quite a bit compared to what you'd pay for the three of them separately per month – 43% on the ad-supported plan and 42% on the ad-free plan.' Recommendation assumes the reader either already subscribes to or wants multiple services; links to a separate guide on how to get or switch to the bundle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Student discount eligibility and redemption
rubrics_metrics.description: Students can score the HBO Max Basic With Ads plan at a 50% discount; price noted as 'just $5.49/month' and elsewhere listed as $4.99 at HBO Max with 'save 50%'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To get the discount you must verify student status with UNiDAYS, which will provide a unique code to redeem the discounted plan. Practical note: verification is required and the discount is only available through the student verification flow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan tiers, pricing, and billing options
rubrics_metrics.description: HBO Max subscription options listed with monthly and annual prices: $10.99/month Basic With Ads; $109.99/year Basic With Ads; $18.49/month Standard (ad-free); $184.99/year Standard (ad-free); Premium tier prices listed as $22.99/month and $229.99/year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose between Basic, Standard, and Premium based on desired ad experience, cost, and features. Annual pricing is an option for lower per-month cost. The article explicitly lists the available price points so readers can compare tiers directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan feature criteria — concurrent streams, resolution, downloads, and audio
rubrics_metrics.description: Basic and Standard tiers allow up to two concurrent streams and offer Full HD resolution; Standard allows downloads. Premium offers 4K UHD resolution, Dolby Atmos sound, and four concurrent streams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select a plan based on technical needs: number of simultaneous viewers, desire for offline downloads, and need for higher-resolution / premium audio. The article emphasizes these feature differences as primary reasons to pick one tier over another.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free trial availability
rubrics_metrics.description: There is currently no HBO Max free trial available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Readers should not expect a trial period; budgeting should assume immediate payment to access content. This affects evaluation of short-term deals or sign-up risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content library as a value metric
rubrics_metrics.description: HBO Max's value is tied to its content selection, including HBO Originals (The Last of Us, Succession, Barry, Curb Your Enthusiasm, The White Lotus, House of the Dragon), DC movies and shows (Superman, Peacemaker), Warner Bros. films (Mickey 17, Sinners), and popular series/collections (Friends, Full House, Harry Potter).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When judging whether HBO Max is worth the price, consider whether the service's library includes titles you want to watch. The guide highlights marquee titles and brands as primary draws.

rubrics_metrics.name: Savings comparison methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: Savings are communicated by comparing bundle price to cost of subscribing separately: 'It'll save you quite a bit compared to what you'd pay for the three of them separately per month – 43% on the ad-supported plan and 42% on the ad-free plan.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use percent-savings versus separate subscriptions as a quick metric for bundle value. The article implies readers should calculate based on their existing subscriptions and viewing habits to determine real savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor for price changes and deals
rubrics_metrics.description: The article states: 'we're keeping track of the best price for subscriptions, along with any deals as they appear.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Readers are advised that pricing and deals change; consult updated guides or the article periodically to find current promotions. This suggests an ongoing evaluation criterion rather than a one-time check.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendation conditional on user circumstances
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'best bet for savings (assuming you're already on the hook for more than one subscription) is by checking out some bundles.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advice is conditional: bundles are best if you already plan to use multiple services. The guide implicitly recommends tailoring the choice to your existing subscriptions and viewing needs rather than applying a single universal 'best' option.
